name: MOT_TERR_METRICS_B
description: This table is used to store the setup for Territory Metrics.

columns.name: TERR_METRIC_ID
columns.description: Primary key.

columns.name: FORECAST_TRENDING_FLAG
columns.description: FORECAST_TRENDING_FLAG

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether the metrics is active or inactive.

columns.name: PARTITION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the dimension partition.

columns.name: METRICS_CODE
columns.description: Code for the metrics.

columns.name: ACTIVATION_REQUEST
columns.description: Activation request to disable or enable the metrics.

columns.name: CALCULATED_FLAG
columns.description: Identify if a metric is calculated based on other metrics. If so, formula definition is required

columns.name: FORMULA_DEFINITION
columns.description: Formula to use in defining a calculated metrics in Essbase outline

columns.name: DRILL_REPORT_PATH
columns.description: Full path of drill report

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Identify if a metric is available in Runtime UI

columns.name: VO_ATTR_NAME
columns.description: View object attribute for storing metrics value

columns.name: METRICS_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Identify the source of the metrics

columns.name: METRICS_QUERY_HANDLER
columns.description: The query handler java implementation class full name. This java class implement the MetricQueryHandler interface that knows how to query up the value for this metrics.

columns.name: METRICS_DRILL_HANDLER
columns.description: The drill handler java implementation class full name. This java class implements the MetricDrillHandler interface that knows how to construct the filter xml string for this metric drill through report.

columns.name: BI_FACT_NAME
columns.description: Identify name of the facts in OBI

columns.name: BI_FACT_ATTR_NAME
columns.description: Identify name of the fact attribute in OBI

columns.name: INTERNAL_FLAG
columns.description: Identify if a metric is internal and should not be exposed to the UI

columns.name: CUMULATIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Indentify if a metric should be aggregated with time balancing

columns.name: CUMULATIVE_HISTORY_REQUIRED
columns.description: Identify if the metric requires to store historical metrics values in the essbase.

columns.name: ASSOCIATED_TIME_ENTITY
columns.description: Identify the time entity name in OBI associated to the metrics for time filtering.

columns.name: ASSOCIATED_TIME_ENTITY_ATTRS
columns.description: Identify a list of attribute names of the time entity

columns.name: TERR_METRIC_SUBJECT_AREA_ID
columns.description: Identify the dimension group that the metric is used

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
